game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market, a forest mushroom market: the fairy gardener must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the fairy gardener moves exactly n steps toward the waterfall gate.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market: a forest mushroom market
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Market, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the fairy gardener moves exactly n steps toward the waterfall gate. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the fairy gardener ahead. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the waterfall gate by solving code steps involving steps_left that move the fairy gardener forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the waterfall gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Mushroom Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Mushroom Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
